worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of finding the zeros of a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n}$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{J}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}f({x}_{n}),
$$

where ${J}_{f}({x}_{n})$ is the Jacobian of $f$ evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

Equivalently, at each iteration, the above equation can be re-written as

$$
{J}_{f}({x}_{n})({x}_{n+1}-{x}_{n})=-f({x}_{n}).
$$

In our case, the Jacobian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{J}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{3}-3xy+{y}^{2}-1) & \frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{3}-3xy+{y}^{2}-1) \\ \frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}+{y}^{3}-2) & \frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}+{y}^{3}-2)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}-3y & 2y-3x \\ 2x & 3{y}^{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson system of equations is

$$
{[\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}-3y & 2y-3x \\ 2x & 3{y}^{2}\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}({x}_{n+1}-{x}_{n})=-{[\begin{aligned}{x}^{3}-3xy+{y}^{2}-1 \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{3}-2\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

Starting with ${x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{[\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}-3y & 2y-3x \\ 2x & 3{y}^{2}\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}}({x}_{1}-{x}_{0}) & =-{[\begin{aligned}{x}^{3}-3xy+{y}^{2}-1 \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{3}-2\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}} \\ [\begin{aligned}3(1)^{2}-3(0) & 2(0)-3(1) \\ 2(1) & 3(0)^{2}\end{aligned}]({x}_{1}-{x}_{0}) & =-[\begin{aligned}{1}^{3}-3(1)(0)+{0}^{2}-1 \\ {1}^{2}+{0}^{3}-2\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3 & -3 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]({x}_{1}-{x}_{0}) & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
html:
The Newton-Raphson method of finding the zeros of a multivariable function f:Rn→Rn is

xn+1=xn−[Jf(xn)]−1f(xn),

where Jf(xn) is the Jacobian of f evaluated at xn.

Equivalently, at each iteration, the above equation can be re-written as

Jf(xn)(xn+1−xn)=−f(xn).

In our case, the Jacobian is

Jf(x)=[∂∂x(x3−3xy+y2−1)∂∂y(x3−3xy+y2−1)∂∂x(x2+y3−2)∂∂y(x2+y3−2)]=[3x2−3y2y−3x2x3y2].

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson system of equations is

[3x2−3y2y−3x2x3y2]xn(xn+1−xn)=−[x3−3xy+y2−1x2+y3−2]xn.

Starting with x0=[10], we have

[3x2−3y2y−3x2x3y2]x0(x1−x0)=−[x3−3xy+y2−1x2+y3−2]x0[3(1)2−3(0)2(0)−3(1)2(1)3(0)2](x1−x0)=−[13−3(1)(0)+02−112+03−2][3−320](x1−x0)=[01].
